sentences.text: Harshit Taparia & Ors vs Unknown on 14 August, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
14.08.2023
Serial no. 5
 [G.S.D]
 Crr 1191 of 2023
 With
 Cran 1 of 2023

In the matter of : Harshit Taparia & Ors.
 ... ...

Petitioners
 Mr. Santanu Talukdar
 Mr. Abdullah Bin Masi
 ...

For the Petitioners
 Mr. Rajnish Kr. Kalawatia
 Mr. Mukesh Pandey
 ...

For the REspondent
Ms. Anusuya Sinha Mr. Saryati Datta Mr. Pinak Kumar Mitra ...

For the State The Report submitted by Mr. Saryati Datta, Learned Advocate for the State enclosing the statement of the defacto-complainant as well as the declaration in connection with Belur P.S. Case No. 52 of 2020 dated 18.03.2020 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the I.P.C. and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, be kept with the record.
The parties have also filed a Joint Compromise Petition.
I have also perused the statement and the declaration made by the lady.
The genesis of the case arises out of a matrimonial discord.

There has been mutual divorce between the parties and, as such,
the defacto-complainant does not intend to proceed with the present criminal case.

Having regard to the chances of conviction being very bleak, I am of the opinion that further continuance of the proceedings of the present case is unwarranted in the changed facts and circumstances of compromise between the parties.

Accordingly, all further proceedings of Belur P.S. Case No. 52 of 2020 dated 18.03.2020 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC and Section 3 and 4 of the DP Act pending before the CJM,
Howrah including the charge-sheet submitted therein is hereby quashed.
With the aforesaid observations, CRR 1191 of 2023 along with CRAN 1 of 2023 is allowed.
Pending application, if any, is also disposed of.
Parties to act on a server copy of this order, duly collected from the official website of the Hon'ble High Court, Calcutta.
Urgent Photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties, subject to compliance with all requisite formalities.
(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
